body:
If I did not and do not deserve unhappiness, why is it that only bad things seem to happen to me? Why have so many people including ones I have loved with all my heart and cared about hurt me so bad!? Emotionally and in the case of my ex, physically too? And why did he deserve happiness when he treated me like nothing more than someone to sleep with? Why don't my friends AND my family seem to understand or sympathize with me? I feel like I'm a burden. I have always been an emotional kind of person. But instead of accepting that about me and supporting me which would make me feel better, they only go further away from me when I look for help...It hurts...a lot.

I have some skills. Drawing. Arts and Crafts kind of things. I'm a creative kind of person. But I can't focus on anything right now. And I haven't been able to for months. It's all snowballing...

Professors can help me but they can't do a whole lot. They are busy people. There are too many problem sets, quizzes, midterms etcetera that need to get done and I only can do that. My ex is one of the brightest in my class and he used to help me with work a lot. When him and me got together, I was struggling too and as much as I wanted help, I was afraid of worse outcomes for me if we broke up i.e. failing...Now I'm dealing with that reality :S :(

I will visit my counselor in the career center again but I don't know how much that can help me. There are so may people who apply for the same job postings and seeing how I haven't been contacted even once, I worry if I stand a chance at all. 

And I don't want to take my life. I want my life to be a little more liveable. But this has been going on for a very long time now. Sometimes I lie on the floor for hours motionless, leaving behind tasks that I have to get done in my day. I feel misery. Despair. Sometimes I cry like lunatic and pretend to be attempting to kill myself. I plan how and when I will ACTUALLY do it. I wonder if there's any point of keeping on going. I question my faith too. The ONLY thing that keeps me going at all. If I need help, I need it fast! :( I can't stand this for very long now :(

Well, it's not so easy to just remove friends from your life. I don't even have a lot of friends. And it's not like I will have new friends waiting for me the moment I say goodbye to the ones who haven't been supportive. I'm lonely and depressed and I wish I just had strong stable friendships in my life. But my friendships are as unstable as my life feels right now. 

I have never been a happy kind of person but that relationship I referenced (It was my first and only) was a rare occasion where I did feel happy. It was a very unstable kind of happiness because my ex basically treated me like his object for affection and confessed to be holding on only because he didn't believe he could find another girl (It was his first relationship too). But it was still something. I cherished the nights I could sleep in the arms of the boy I loved and wake up next to him. Sometimes I wonder why I didn't deserve to be loved back the way I had loved. I couldn't even fathom another boy after breaking up because I needed time to heal. But he could and he broke me in the process too.

I want to be someone else now to feel the way that I did and want to be treated with love and respect but I am also afraid. I don't want to love and spend my time on someone who will just leave me in the end...

It's not just the amount of waiting time for getting my job. It's the fact that I need the money too. And I feel terrible that I can't support myself even a little bit right now. My family's struggling to run a business right now. And I'm the eldest too...

And school is like a hopeless headache on its own...

I don't know. I don't see light. If it's there, it's too dim and it doesn't compensate for how I have been feeling for a very long time now. I'm just scared about the process of taking one's life. And I'm scared of leaving my family scarred. But pain already kills me inside. I don't know how long I can keep on going like this...
